prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a NEW original photographic campaign asset for Frontaliere Ticino, a service that finds Swiss job offers suitable for a person's trade and prepares the applications for them. The provided images are REFERENCE IMAGES for the intended audience and practical working-world visual language, not edit targets; do not copy their layout, text, person identity or branding verbatim. Audience is ordinary Italian-speaking job seekers, especially tradespeople, production, maintenance and logistics workers. Visually direct, trustworthy and immediately Swiss; not luxury-office, fintech, abstract CV stationery or aspirational executive advertising. Premium realistic commercial photography with strong clear shapes, authentic faces, practical workwear, crisp focus, decisive contrast. Natural Swiss-red, navy and real workwear colors. A Swiss national flag can appear clearly in the environment (not a humanitarian Red Cross emblem). No company logos, no invented employer, no salary or job guarantee. No embedded words, lettering, numerals, icons, badges or button; the real advertisement will add very large HTML headline 'LAVORO IN SVIZZERA? LO CERCHIAMO NOI PER TE.' and CTA above/beside this photo. The image itself must feature the intended worker prominently, with a strong recognisable human face even at 100px crop width. Aspect PORTRAIT1:2. An authentic skilled maintenance technician around45, natural feminine appearance, practical navy workshop overalls and protective glasses resting correctly on the head away from machinery, in a clean precision-maintenance workshop in Switzerland. Half-body portrait, face clearly visible in upper third, simple unbranded hand tool safely carried at waist level, no active electrical repair or unsafe pose. Warm approachable capable expression; a small Swiss flag visible in workshop background. Crisp tactile work clothes and strong contrast. Centered subject inside central60% for narrow160px and rectangular ad crops.
